text_block_list.text:
On the way home from a day out somewhere a 
bit far with Taiki Shuttle—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Halt, student of the Academy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What!? That voice is...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's the student council! What are you 
doing out this late—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? If it isn't Taiki. And the one next to 
you is...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Air Groove! Over here is my 
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...If their trainer is with them, there 
shouldn't be a problem. I'm sure they 
properly obtained an off-campus pass.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Pardon me for stopping you. I heard 
public morals have been slipping even 
outside the academy lately, so I was on 
extra high alert."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There's no problem with that, but... make 
sure you go straight home without taking 
any detours.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Understood~! In that case, let's go home 
together with Air Groove too!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, I still have patrol duty to—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, patrol duty... In that case, I will 
join you! It's not fair if you're the only 
one having fun!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, this isn't a game! Hey, her Trainer, 
do something about Taiki!
choice_data_list: Let them do as they please

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh-Why are you ignoring it...? Hey, you—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! I will do my best on patrol! Air 
Groove always looks like she has it tough, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem! I'll do it right. I'll read it 
as 'seriousness' and write it as 'for 
real'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's get startin' right away!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey, don't just start on your own!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you over there! Stop right there! 
Yes, you in the Tracen Academy uniform!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm, have you already spotted some students 
out late at night? You're surprisingly 
capable...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's go on patrol together, you~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Make them go home! Good grief, my 
head hurts...!

Even while being scolded by Air Groove, 
Taiki Shuttle did her best to help out 
with patrols.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's no good, huh... But you're 
right. The full moon is already high in 
the sky today...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Air Groove, we are heading 
home.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, head back and get some rest. Now 
then, as for my duties...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, goodbye, Air Groove! I really 
wanted to go on patrol with you, DEEEESU!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna stop, now's the time, you 
know? Shall we stop? I'm ready anytime, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I won't stop you, so hurry home and rest! 
Ah— if you just want to hang out, I'll 
make another opportunity later.

I dragged a reluctant Taiki Shuttle back 
to the dorms so she could get an early 
rest.
